title: Batch pnpm installs ignore the repository pnpmfile
summary: The console batch install for pnpm now passes --ignore-pnpmfile as well as --ignore-scripts, so a repository's .pnpmfile.cjs hook no longer runs in the batch worktree. Yarn 2 and later yarnPath and plugins, and settings configured in .npmrc, still apply; the contract and preview now say so.
